reference: The original GGML Q8_K dequantizer and original generic Q4_1 × Q8_1 dot product against 32 one-hot basis rows supply the two activation reads. GGML dequantize_row_q4_1 independently checks each basis coordinate. Source blocks include positive and negative non-unit scales, signed byte extrema, and stored per-block sums. The five scalar numeric sources use original GGML and Berkeley SoftFloat conversions. Decode the remaining inputs with GGML, reverse the two right rows, evaluate 520 unique original F32 arithmetic graphs, and encode each result with original GGML or SoftFloat.
